propositions: The undecomposed and dod_uncertifiable severity axes currently use unreliable ordinal labels (low/medium/high) that must be replaced with closed-set kind enumerations mapping deterministically to floor-vs-advisory outcomes.
Both axes must be converted behind a single IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION bump from plan-v4 to plan-v5 per ADR 0054 section 4, batching all shape changes together with the inert G5-suppressor hedge removal.

The undecomposed axis must map to six kinds (none, bundles_separable_slices→0.55, missing_required_child→0.85, no_executable_breakdown→0.85) and dod_uncertifiable to six kinds (none, underspecified_certification→0.55, uncertifiable_outcome→0.85, certification_cannot_prove→0.85) with advisory kinds never flooring and gap kinds always flooring.

Verifier prompts must be rewritten to enumerate all six kinds per axis with deterministic pick-rules, removing G5-suppressor hedges, and impact_plan must be updated across all three usage points (_PLAN_SEVERITY_AXES, _PLAN_HARD_OVERRIDE_AXES, and amplifier force) to read the new kind maps.

A zero-LLM re-score script must audit the corpus of 22,667 findings against the new mapping rules, report old-vs-new decision flips with pessimistic and optimistic bounds for rule-unmatched rows, and escalate only if an unjustified lost block is found (a gap condition mapping to advisory).

Decision-margin telemetry recording the per-finding priority minus block_threshold margin must be added to the sidecar as an additive-only change, with all test cases rewritten to use kind names instead of ordinal labels and new test coverage added for the advisory kinds.
